items.transcript: I made this frame for our TV, and it honestly is so much easier than it looks. I used a few pieces of wood, cut the ends at an angle, and joined them together with brackets. Then I added some decorative details, filled any gaps, and sprayed everything black. Once that dried, I added gold spray paint to give it that vintage look. I added elastic to the back to keep the frame secure around the TV, and that's it! It's such a simple DIY, but adds so much character to the room. Let me know what you guys think.

items.transcript: Here are a few cleaning hacks you need to know. Got a smelly drain? Add baking soda and lemon juice, let it sit for 15 minutes, then rinse it with hot water to freshen it up. Add a bowl of foil to the dishwasher, run a normal cycle, and let it help bring the shine back to your silverware. If you love clean floors but hate mopping, a steaming scrub cleaner makes the job so much easier. If you want to reuse a candle jar, pop it in the freezer for a few hours, the wax comes out so easy and the jar is ready to reuse.

items.caption:
